# Elora

> Elora is a voice-first AI journaling application for iOS and Android that
> transcribes journal entries, detects emotional patterns, and generates
> personalized insights. All entries are encrypted end-to-end. Elora is free
> to download with an optional Elora Premium subscription.

## Download
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/au/app/elora-journal-with-insight/id6753067869
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.elora.ai

## Core Features
- Voice journaling with automatic transcription
- Text journaling
- AI-generated summaries, themes, and emotional tags
- Emotional pattern detection across entries
- Explore: conversational chat with your journal history
- Soul Map: graph visualization of recurring themes and connections
- Offline-first storage with secure cloud sync
- Guided reflection prompts
- End-to-end encryption
- No ads, no data selling, no AI training on user entries

## Pricing
- Free: journaling, AI summaries, voice transcription, pattern tracking
- Elora Premium: USD 4.99/month (Monthly or Annual) — unlimited Explore chat, advanced insights

## Privacy
- End-to-end encryption for all journal entries
- No data sold, no ads, no model training on user entries
- AI processing by providers including Anthropic and OpenAI
- Full privacy policy: https://elora.day/privacy-policy
